title: One-point fluctuations for exponential last passage percolation under upper-tail conditioning
summary: We study exponential directed last passage percolation conditioned on the last passage time to a specified macroscopic point being atypically large. We determine the one-point fluctuations throughout two of the three spatial regions arising under this conditioning, as well as on the boundaries between these regions, extending the work of Baik-Cordaro-Tripathi. Depending on the location of the observation point, the limiting fluctuations are governed by the GUE Tracy-Widom distribution, a Gaussian distribution, or the one-spike BBP distribution on the boundaries between these regions.
